structures.name: Habenula
structures.note: Modelled as a single midline element in the source asset.

structures.note: Midbrain tissue not covered by the separately modelled colliculi and cerebral peduncles.

structures.name: Cerebral peduncles
structures.note: Single element covering both peduncles. The substantia nigra lies within this region but is NOT separately segmented in the source asset.

structures.name: Cerebellum
structures.note: Single element in the source asset: cerebellar hemispheres and vermis are not separately segmented.

unavailable.name: Left cerebellar hemisphere
unavailable.reason: BodyParts3D 3.0 models the cerebellum as one element.
unavailable.requiredAsset: A cerebellar parcellation (e.g. SUIT atlas lobules) converted to surface meshes.

unavailable.name: Right cerebellar hemisphere
unavailable.reason: BodyParts3D 3.0 models the cerebellum as one element.
unavailable.requiredAsset: A cerebellar parcellation (e.g. SUIT atlas lobules) converted to surface meshes.

unavailable.name: Cerebellar vermis
unavailable.reason: BodyParts3D 3.0 models the cerebellum as one element.
unavailable.requiredAsset: A cerebellar parcellation separating vermis from hemispheres.

unavailable.name: Inferior frontal gyrus (incl. Broca's area)
unavailable.reason: Not present as an element in BodyParts3D 3.0; the frontal lobe groups contain only superior, middle and precentral gyri plus the bilateral orbital/straight gyri element.
unavailable.requiredAsset: A cortical parcellation including the pars opercularis/triangularis/orbitalis (e.g. Desikan-Killiany surfaces).

unavailable.name: Substantia nigra
unavailable.reason: Lies within the cerebral peduncle element; not separately segmented.
unavailable.requiredAsset: A high-resolution midbrain atlas (e.g. CIT168 subcortical atlas) converted to meshes.

unavailable.name: Nucleus accumbens
unavailable.reason: Not present as an element in BodyParts3D 3.0.
unavailable.requiredAsset: A subcortical atlas with ventral striatum labels (e.g. CIT168 or Harvard-Oxford subcortical).

unavailable.name: Cuneus / lingual gyrus / calcarine cortex
unavailable.reason: BodyParts3D provides each occipital lobe as a single element.
unavailable.requiredAsset: A cortical parcellation with medial occipital labels.

unavailable.name: Cranial nerves III–XII
unavailable.reason: Only the optic nerve (CN II) was integrated; other cranial-nerve elements were not part of this build.
unavailable.requiredAsset: BodyParts3D cranial nerve elements or a dedicated cranial-nerve model, re-registered to the brain.

unavailable.name: Major white-matter tracts (tractography)
unavailable.reason: Only a coarse white-matter envelope, corpus callosum, fornix and anterior limb of internal capsule exist in the asset.
unavailable.requiredAsset: A tractography atlas (e.g. HCP-842) converted to streamline or tube meshes.
